message: You got your first curl working in Huddle.
what_just_happened: curl read http_proxy from the container's environment and sent the request to huddle:80.
infosupport.github.io was not on any allow list, so the gateway held the request and raised a pending rule.
You approved it. The gateway opened the connection on the bridge network and handed you this file.
TLS was terminated by the gateway — its CA is already in the container's trust store, which is why no -k was needed.
next: Step 2 — mount your own project and find out which of your dependencies need rules of their own.
